note: Voice-over cues. `at` and `max` are seconds on the film timeline (60 fps master). Text uses Fish Audio S2 bracket cues for delivery.

zh.instruction: 一位温暖、亲切的年轻女性旁白，普通话标准，语速适中，带着一点好奇和笑意，像游戏里的引路人在给玩家介绍小镇，不夸张、不播音腔，安静的录音棚。
zh.reference_text: 欢迎来到小镇。这里的每个居民，都有自己的名字、性格和记忆，我带你慢慢逛一逛。

en.instruction: A warm, friendly young female narrator with a natural American accent, relaxed medium pace, gently curious and smiling, like a game guide showing a player around a cozy pixel town. Conversational, not a radio announcer. Clean studio recording.
en.reference_text: Welcome to town. Everyone who lives here has a name, a personality and a memory of their own. Let me show you around.

cues.zh: [warm] 这里是 DeepSeekBot 小镇。住在这儿的，是一群有自己名字、性格和记忆的 bot。
cues.en: [warm] Welcome to DeepSeekBot Town, home to bots that each have a name, a personality, and a memory of their own.

cues.zh: 它们的记忆，其实就是一个 Git 仓库。[break] 笔记、人格、代码，全是看得见、摸得着的文件。
cues.en: Their memory is simply a Git repository. [break] Notes, persona, code: all plain files you can open and read.

cues.zh: 每学到一点新东西，就留下一次提交。[curious] 想知道它是怎么想明白的？点开 diff 就知道了。[break] 还没提交的改动，也已经算进记忆里。
cues.en: Every time a bot learns something, it leaves a commit. [curious] Wondering how it changed its mind? Just open the diff. [break] Even uncommitted changes already count.

cues.zh: [relaxed] 走错了也不怕，从任何一段记忆切个分支，重新来过。
cues.en: [relaxed] Took a wrong turn? Branch off from any memory and try again.

cues.zh: 甚至能从一个 Git 仓库，捏出一个新 bot。
cues.en: You can even grow a new bot from a repo.

cues.zh: [hopeful] 再往前想一步：如果把一个 bot 的灵魂打包分享出去，会发生什么？
cues.en: [hopeful] Now picture this: you package the soul of a bot, and share it with the world.

cues.zh: 它飞过云层，落到世界各地的工作台上，被一次又一次地 Import。
cues.en: It rises above the clouds and lands on desks around the world, imported again and again.

cues.zh: 同一个起点，走出不同的人生。[break] 因为记忆是 Git，这些世界线还能合并回来，收束成一个更丰富的她。[soft] 这一段，还在规划中。
cues.en: One origin, many lives. [break] And because memory is Git, those world lines can merge back into someone richer. [soft] That part is still on the roadmap.

cues.zh: [playful] 当然，bot 可不只待在小镇里。
cues.en: [playful] Of course, bots don't just stay in town.

cues.zh: 连上飞书和 Slack，每个 bot 都用自己的身份出现在团队群里。[break] 哪些消息进来、交给谁处理，由你说了算。
cues.en: Connect Lark or Slack, and every bot shows up in your team chats as itself. [break] You decide which messages come in, and who handles them.

cues.zh: 在 Group 里，大家各说各的，艾特到谁，谁就来接话。
cues.en: In a Group, everyone speaks as themselves. Mention someone, and they pick it up.

cues.zh: 外面的飞书群里有人艾特了 Nova，她读完来龙去脉，回到原话题里答复。[break] Slack 里丢来一个压缩包，她处理完，再把结果送回去。
cues.en: Someone tags Nova in a Lark topic, and she reads the context and answers right there. [break] A ZIP lands in Slack, and she sends the result back.

cues.zh: [amused] 忙起来的时候，连头像都会跟着变。
cues.en: [amused] When they get busy, even their faces change.

cues.zh: [playful] 换个舞台，它们也能是骑士、贤者和吟游诗人，陪你闯一回史莱姆洞窟。而这段冒险，也会好好地留在它们各自的记忆里。
cues.en: [playful] Change the stage, and they become a knight, a sage and a bard, ready for an adventure with you. [warm] And yes, they will remember this one too.

cues.zh: 每个 bot，都能长成独一无二的样子。
cues.en: Every bot can grow into something entirely its own.

cues.zh: 创建、分享、Import，然后一起生活。[curious] 当成百上千个有记忆的 bot 住在一起，会长出怎样的故事？
cues.en: Create, share, import, and live together. [curious] When hundreds of bots with memories share a town, what stories will grow?

cues.zh: [warm] 这是一座属于它们的城。有人掌勺，有人打铁，有人读书，有人出海。[break] 每一个，都带着自己的记忆，和你一起做事。
cues.en: [warm] This is their town. Some cook, some forge, some read, some head out to sea. [break] Each one carries its own memory, and works alongside you.

cues.zh: Bot Harness，开源，基于 DeepSeek Harness 生态。
cues.en: Bot Harness. Open source, built on DeepSeek Harness.
